result.summary: The home screen is mostly well laid out. The main defect is a data-binding failure in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, where the Smash Bros Burgers delivery fee shows 'NaN'. Some minor styling and contrast concerns also exist.

issues.description: The Smash Bros Burgers card shows '€NaN delivery' instead of a real delivery fee. This is a data or formatting error, and it leaves users without pricing information.
issues.suggestion: Fix the delivery fee calculation or data binding. Validate the value before rendering, and use a fallback such as 'Delivery fee unavailable' or hide the fee if the data is missing.

issues.description: The secondary gray text (delivery fees, 'min', rating count, inactive nav labels) is light on a white background and has low contrast. The white time pills over light food images, such as the 15–25 min pill on the poké card, also blend into the background.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text to meet WCAG AA 4.5:1 contrast. Add a subtle shadow or border to the overlay pills.

issues.description: The heart/favorite button on the pizza card is a dark translucent circle that has weak visual separation from the dark background, and it is inconsistent with the ramen card's button. The illustrated placeholder food images also look flat and inconsistent with the rest of the UI.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent favorite button style with sufficient contrast, such as a light translucent background. Replace the placeholders with real photography.
